name: What is the typical process for installing new French doors in a residential remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for installing new French doors in a residential remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for installing new French doors as part of a residential remodel typically begins with a detailed design consultation to understand your vision and assess the structural requirements. AKN Design Group then handles comprehensive planning, including CAD-supported layouts and permit coordination, to ensure proper integration with your home's existing structure and aesthetic. This is followed by careful removal of existing structures, preparation of the opening, precise installation of the new French doors, and finish work. Our integrated design-build approach ensures a seamless transition from concept to completion, with a single accountable team managing every phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process for installing French doors involves design consultation, CAD planning, permit coordination, precise installation, and finish work, all managed by one team.
